name: data-grid-lazy
title: Data Grid Lazy
author: gridcn
description: Virtual data fetching add-on for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridLazyRows maintains a sparse data array and fetches row windows on demand from onRenderedRowsChange, with range coalescing, in-flight dedup, abort-on-unmount, and error revert/refetch. useDataGridInfiniteRows does the same for a source with no known total (cursor chain, skeleton rows grow in steps). A dev-only DataGridLazyGuard warns when uncontrolled sort/filter/search fires while rows are still unloaded.
